title: Unchanged number of lawyers with active licenses to practice in cities within Ashley County in May compared to previous month
text:
Unchanged number of lawyers with active licenses to practice in cities within Ashley County in May compared to previous month
There was no change in the number of lawyers with active licenses in cities within Ashley County in May compared to the previous month, according to the Arkansas Judiciary.
In total, there were three active legal licenses recorded in the county at the time.
Data refers to all lawyers who were actively practicing during this time period. Lawyers in good standing do not have any complaints or disciplinary actions being taken against them.
Arkansas recorded one of the highest percentage increases in resident active attorneys nationwide from 2024 to 2025, with a growth of 11.75%, according to the ABA’s 2025 Profile of the Legal Profession. The number of resident active lawyers in the state rose from 6,808 in 2024 to 7,608 in 2025.
As of June 1, 2026, average lawyer salaries in Arkansas ranged from $90,391 for an entry-level attorney handling routine legal work (Attorney I) to $228,996 for highly experienced attorneys managing complex cases with significant autonomy (Attorney V). Mid-level attorneys, such as those in Attorney III roles—who handle highly complex legal work with moderate supervision—earn on average $169,484 in Arkansas, compared to $187,607 nationwide.
The United States has more than 1.3 million active lawyers, with employment projected to grow 4% between 2024 and 2034, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
